name: Floating Side Tab
author: WP Shuffle

sections.description:
Floating Side Tab is a powerful and lightweight WordPress plugin that lets you add fully customizable sticky side tabs to your website. Use floating side tabs to showcase social icons, quick links, contact forms, or any custom HTML content using shortcodes.

🎯 Improve user engagement, highlight important info, and enhance navigation with a floating side tab that sticks to any page of your site.

👉 Live Demo | Try PRO Version

Introducing the Floating Side Tab plugin – a free WordPress plugin to add floating, sticky tabs to the left or right side of your website. Choose from 8 pre-designed templates and display unlimited tab icons, each with its own content or link.

Display dynamic content using shortcodes or HTML, link directly to internal or external pages, or just highlight key features of your business with ease. Floating Side Tab helps boost conversions and provides users with quick access to what matters most.

Floating Side Tab Features:

  • Unlimited Floating Side Tab Menus
  • 8 Pre-designed Floating Tab Templates
  • Custom HTML and Shortcode Support
  • Individual Icon Color Customization
  • 3000+ Font Icons
  • Multiple Tab Positions (Left/Right)
  • Easy Setup & Intuitive Interface
  • Backend Live Preview
  • Fully Responsive & Cross-browser Compatible

Floating Side Tab PRO Features:

  • Articles Tab with 5 Layouts
  • WooCommerce Products Tab with 5 Layouts
  • Social Icons Tab with 4 Layouts
  • Built-in Contact Form Tab (5 Layouts)
  • Subscription Form Tab (5 Layouts)
  • 20+ Floating Menu Templates
  • Custom HTML Tab with Advanced Display Options
  • More Tab Positions: Top Left, Top Right, Bottom Left, Bottom Right
  • 9000+ Icons to Choose From

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/floating-side-tab directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Configure the Floating Side Tab menu settings from the plugin admin panel.
sections.faq:
What is Floating Side Tab?

Floating Side Tab is a WordPress plugin that lets you add sticky side tab menus to your website. These tabs can contain social links, contact forms, custom HTML, shortcodes, or links to internal/external pages.

Do I need to design the floating tab myself?

No. Floating Side Tab comes with 8 professionally designed templates that you can use instantly. Just pick a template, customize it, and you’re good to go.

Can I use shortcodes inside the Floating Side Tab content?

Yes! Floating Side Tab supports all WordPress shortcodes. You can easily embed forms, galleries, or any dynamic content by pasting the shortcode into the tab content editor.

How many icons are available to use?

The free version includes over 3,000 icons. The PRO version unlocks access to 9,000+ icons for greater customization of each tab.

Can I display different floating tabs on different pages?

Yes, Floating Side Tab allows you to create multiple tab menus and assign them to specific pages or posts.

Can the tab open a custom link instead of showing content?

Absolutely. You can set the tab to either open content in a slide-out panel or redirect users to a custom URL.

Is the Floating Side Tab mobile-friendly?

Yes. Floating Side Tab is fully responsive and works on all screen sizes and modern browsers.

Will it slow down my website?

No. Floating Side Tab is lightweight and optimized for performance, ensuring minimal impact on your site’s loading speed.

Do I need coding knowledge to use this plugin?

Not at all! Floating Side Tab is beginner-friendly with a visual backend interface. You can manage everything through the WordPress dashboard without writing a single line of code.

How can I get access to more features?

You can upgrade to Floating Side Tab PRO for advanced layouts, additional templates, built-in forms, WooCommerce support, and more.
